To suggest apps you have not opened in 90+ days, Midiastore reads only the last-used timestamps of installed apps via Android Usage Access. This data is processed 100% locally on your device and is never sent, stored on external servers, or shared with third parties.

Monthly and Annual plans are subscriptions with automatic renewal via Google Play until cancelled. You can cancel anytime in Google Play Store before the renewal date. The Lifetime plan is a one-time payment.
